evidence.name: Screen field: Style the plan note (bottom-left)
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Style the plan note (bottom-left)" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Style the plan note (bottom-left)
sections.description: Styles the bottom-left label on every plan card, usually the short plan description or trial note: font, size, weight, color, alignment, and spacing, applied to all plans at once. This sets only the look; you write the actual text per plan in the plan list. Keep it smaller and lighter than the plan name; theme defaults are a safe start.
